heading: Bigg Boss Malayalam 8 Contestants List: Gayathri Suresh, Rahul Easwar enter Mohanlal’s show
paragraphs: Bigg Boss Malayalam Season 8 Contestants Name List: Bigg Boss Malayalam, one of the most beloved reality television programmes, has received yet another edition, with superstar Mohanlal returning as the host for the eighth time in a row. Ten months after the last season ended, Bigg Boss Malayalam Season 8 was launched on Sunday evening, September 6, when the acting legend officially unveiled the contestants’ names.
Bigg Boss Malayalam 8 Contestants LIVE Updates: Rahul Easwar, Gayathri Suresh, Sreelakshmi Arakkal enter Mohanlal’s show

Mohanlal kicked off the opening ceremony with a powerful message on democracy, emphasising that true power rests with the people. Afterwards, he introduced the contestants one by one. Actor Gayathri Suresh, known for her performances in movies such as Jamna Pyari, Ore Mugham, and Oru Mexican Aparatha, was the first to enter the house. YouTuber Sreeraj (Kadal Komban) soon joined her.

The remaining contestants who entered the reality television programme are television actor-dancer Mridhula Vijai, activist Sreelakshmi Arackal, social media content creator Vighnesh Venu (Wikky Thug), journalist-turned-actor Rini Ann George, actor-writer Noby Binu, RJ and drama tutor Aiswarya Babu, television actor Sreelaya, RJ Anjali, actor Sumesh Chandran, content creator Neha Fathima, fight master Dhanya Kaali, stand-up comedian Gautham G Sasi, content creator Mohammed Azif, actor and fitness enthusiast Jaseela Parveen, and right-wing political commentator Rahul Easwar.

Unlike previous seasons, the programme had a pre-show, Bigg Boss Agnipareeksha, this time to select commoners for the main show. This format was inspired by the Telugu version of the reality show’s spin-off of the same name. While show alumna Reneesha Rahiman hosted Agnipareeksha, former contestants Ranjini Haridas, Riyas Salim, and Akhil Marar served as judges. The segment had 12 finalists, and among them, Shijin, Loletta, Rakesh, and Eldho entered the house.

Along with Bigg Boss Malayalam Season 8, the Salman Khan-hosted Bigg Boss Hindi Season 20, Vijay Sethupathi’s Bigg Boss Tamil Season 10, Kichcha Sudeepa’s Bigg Boss Kannada Season 13, and Nagarjuna’s Bigg Boss Telugu Season 10 also premiered on Sunday.
